text.en:
Section one thousand and forty-five of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven, known
as the Administrative Code, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1045. Payment of expenses incident to care of insane person.-The expense of sending an insane
person to a hospital or other place for the insane, and of his maintenance therein, shall be paid by the guardian
from the property of such insane person, if any there be, or by the person whose duty it is to care for such
insane person. In all cases where the insane patient, or the person responsible for his support, is unable wholly
or in part to pay the expenses of the patient's transportation to the hospital and return, or for his maintenance
and care while at the hospital, the same, or such part thereof as may remain unpaid, shall be paid by the
Bureau of Health: Provided, That whenever a person is found to be insane and it is determined that he is a
danger to himself or to others or that he requires hospitalization, he shall be transferred immediately from his
home community to a provincial or other Government Hospital, or to the Insular Psychopathic Hospital, and
his traveling expenses shall be paid by the Bureau of Health, any other provisions of law to the contrary
notwithstanding."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 1, 1935.
